map.输入胬肉各部位测量值，计算角膜侵入比例与分级。单位均为毫米(mm)。: Enter pterygium measurements at each site to compute corneal invasion ratio and grade. All units are millimeters (mm).
map.翼状胬肉按角膜侵入距离 head（mm）分级：小于1.5 T1 静止、不超过3: Pterygium is graded by corneal invasion distance head (mm): <1.5 T1 quiescent, <=3 T2 moderate, <=4.5 T3 severe, >4.5 T4 critical (reaching pupil); corneal coverage = head ÷ (corneal diameter ÷ 2) × 100% (cap 100), area ≈ head × width.
map.示意图：橙色三角为胬肉，侵入角膜区域: Diagram: the orange triangle is the pterygium, invading the cornea
map.分级基于角膜侵入距离。遮盖瞳孔区(T4)需手术干预。: Grading is based on corneal invasion distance. Covering the pupil (T4) needs surgical intervention.
map.⚠️ 测量需在裂隙灯下完成。胬肉侵入瞳孔区或影响视力时建议手术治疗。: ⚠️ Measurement must be done under a slit lamp. Surgery is advised when the pterygium invades the pupil or affects vision.
map.测量胬肉头端侵入距离、体部宽度和长度，计算角膜遮盖比例并按T分级评估严重程度，辅: Measure pterygium head invasion distance, body width and length, compute corneal coverage ratio and grade by T to assess severity and aid surgical decisions.
map.测角膜横径 cd 与侵入距离 head，算覆盖比与面积。: Measure corneal transverse diameter cd and invasion distance head; compute coverage ratio and area.
map.head 接近半径（覆盖比→高）且累及光学区，手术指征更强。: Head near the radius (coverage → high) and involving the optical zone gives a stronger surgical indication.
map.无绝对界值，但侵入瞳孔区、影响视力或反复炎症者通常建议手术。: No absolute threshold, but invasion of the pupil, vision impact or recurrent inflammation usually suggests surgery.
map.近似为侵入距离×颈部宽度（head×width），为规划用简化模型。: Approximated as invasion distance × neck width (head × width), a simplified model for planning.
map.翼状胬肉测量器：测量胬肉头端位置、体部长度宽度及侵入角膜范围，计算胬肉分级与角膜: Pterygium measurer: measures pterygium head position, body length and width and corneal invasion range, computes grade and corneal coverage ratio. A medical professional tool based on authoritative standards, for reference only.
